label: D1 after an a2 choice that rarely landed in S1 (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2). Almost all mass (89%) comes after a previous a2 choice, and 86% after a rare transition. Since a2 rare means the agent reached S1, the unit fires at D1 after an a2 -> S1 rare trial (prev_action==2 & prev_state==1 is the same predicate). Base predicate (D1, prev a2, prev rare): dev recall 0.79, mass recall 0.85, precision 0.20. The unit is strongly modulated by episode time: almost silent before trial ~30, and its rate rises steadily toward trials 80-99. Adding ep_trial>=50 roughly doubles precision (F1 0.44, mass recall 0.77). Magnitude is highest when the previous rare trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1; adding it gives precision 0.37 and covers 86% of the top quartile), and the top windows come after several a2->S1 rare trials in a row. Activations are also concentrated where the model value is low (<7.5) and the policy mildly favors a2. Many a2->S1R rewarded D1 steps stay silent, especially in long rewarded a2 streaks, so precision stays low. It does not fire after a1 choices, after common a2 trials (except weakly), or at GO/D2. Predicate uses only observed history.
